subject: Private Offer for ZenithPilot — approval stages, term options, and co-sell entitlements
content:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer for ZenithPilot — approval stages, term options, and co-sell entitlements

Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attaching a concise private-offer summary tailored to the ZenithPilot POC. Key things we need to align on before we submit a private offer:

- Target term length (12 vs 24 months) and whether you want annual renewal windows
- Pricing anchor for first-year consumption (commit vs pay-as-you-go mix)
- Buyer-side approval path (single procurement sign-off vs multi-bu approvals)
- Co-sell entitlements (joint logos, solution brief, sales-engine access)

I've attached a one-pager quote and a draft SOW that maps delivery milestones to billing. From a Redwood side, we can do a 12-month term with a 20% up-front commitment or a 24-month term with a 10% annualized discount — both options include co-sell benefits once the private offer is accepted.

Next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm whether procurement requires multi-division signoff (if so, we should expect a 10–14 day approval window).
2) Decide on term preference so we can lock in pricing and get the legal PO template ready.
3) If you want co-sell enablement in Q2, we should finalize the private offer this month to align marketing assets.

Attaching: redwood-private-offer-quote.pdf (pdf), sow-zenithpilot-draft.docx (docx)

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call.

— Dev


From: Emily Ross <procurement@greenfield.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@greenfield.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for ZenithPilot — approval stages, term options, and co-sell entitlements

Thanks, Dev.

A few procurement clarifications from our side:
- Zenith's procurement policy requires a single legal PO for software purchases under $250k, but anything above that needs a second signatory from the analytics BU. Can you confirm expected first-year spend under the two term options?
- We need a statement of data handling for the POC (SOC2 in-scope items and regional controls). Can you supply a short evidence bundle?
- For co-sell, legal wants to confirm marketing rights — are we allowed to publicly list GreenField as a reference after POC completion?

If you can provide numbers and a redline-friendly PO template, we'll route internally.

— Emily


On Fri, Apr 11, 2025 at 12:20 PM Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Emily/Team —
>
> Quick answers inline:
>
> - Expected spend: 12-month option estimate = $190,000 (50% commit / 50% usage buffer). 24-month option estimate = $340,000 (30% commit year 1, lower unit rates in year 2). Those are conservative — final numbers will depend on token usage profile.
> - Evidence bundle: attaching our SOC2 summary and data residency note (we host US-region keys by default for private offers). See attached "redwood-private-offer-quote.pdf" for the short summary; I can follow up with the full compliance packet if needed.
> - Marketing rights: yes, we allow reference use after mutual signoff — we'll have a brief testimony/API in the co-sell package but won't publish detailed technical configs without explicit permission.
>
> Uploading a simple PO template as well (PDF in the attachments) — if you want a Word redline, I can send that too.
>
> If procurement wants, we can pause on co-sell public announcements until the SOW milestone 2 completion.
>
> — Dev


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private Offer for ZenithPilot — internal: approval staging and legal handoff

Team —

Emily's ask is typical. Proposed internal approach from Sales Ops / Legal coord:

1) Pre-submit (sales): confirm term (Dev to confirm) and attach commitment numbers so Marketplace listing uses correct pricing bands.
2) Legal review (3 business days): we run the PO/TSAs against our standard private-offer template; flag any indemnity or IP changes.
3) Finance sign-off (1 business day): confirm revenue recognition and invoice cadence.
4) Marketplace submission: partner ops / marketplace team pushes the private offer draft to AWS (we'll need the buyer org ID and contact email).

Marcus — can you queue Partner Ops to prepare the AWS private offer form once Dev confirms the buyer org ID? Monica, can you draft the single-signature PO variant for Emily to redline?

— Vanessa


On Mon, Apr 13, 2025 at 08:22 AM Emily Ross <procurement@greenfield.ai> wrote:
> Dev/Vanessa/Monica —
>
> Quick follow-ups after internal triage:
>
> 1) Procurement will accept the 12-month option if you can split the invoice into two equal invoices (30 days apart) and provide a CSV-enabled usage report monthly.
> 2) We need a confirmation that keys and logs for the pilot will be retained for 90 days; can you document retention policy?
> 3) Finally — the analytics BU wants a one-week window post-acceptance to confirm internal budget before the final PO is signed (so expect a 7–10 day approval latency).
>
> We'll be ready to progress once the above are confirmed.
>
> — Emily


From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Ross <procurement@greenfield.ai>, Alex Chen <alex@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2025 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer for ZenithPilot — approval stages, term options, and co-sell entitlements

Emily —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirmations below so you have a single-threaded record:

- Invoice split: we can issue two equal invoices for the 12-month option, net 30 each. Finance confirms this is feasible; invoices will reference the AWS private offer ID and Redwood's contract number.
- Retention: logs and API call records retained for 90 days by default for the pilot; we will provide a PDF policy excerpt (attached). For customers that need longer retention, we offer an add-on.
- Approval latency: noted. We'll submit the private offer but mark the effective date as the final PO signature date to accommodate your internal one-week hold.

Next actions (owners):
- Dev: submit private offer draft to PartnerOps with buyer org ID (Alex to share), target: EOD Wed 4/16.
- Alex: please send buyer org ID + procurement contact phone.
- Monica: send single-signature PO template to Emily for redline, target: Tue 4/15.
- Vanessa/Marcus: PartnerOps to ready marketplace form and region alignment.

I'll attach the compliance excerpt and the final quote to the HubSpot deal after this thread.

Cheers —
Dev

Attachments referenced: redwood-private-offer-quote.pdf (pdf), sow-zenithpilot-draft.docx (docx), redwood-compliance-excerpt.pdf (pdf)
